{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
if data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any():
    data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
else:
    data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].astype(float)

# Check for QA test orders: revenue == 999999.99
qa_mask = (data['revenue'] == '999999.99')
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()
print(f"Number of QA test orders (revenue == '999999.99'):", qa_count)

# Exclude refunded orders and QA test orders
completed_only = data[data['status'] == 'completed']
if qa_count > 0:
    completed_only = completed_only[~qa_mask]

# Verify the population: completed orders only, no QA, no refunded
print(f"Number of completed orders after removing QA and refunded:", len(completed_only))

# Compute overall average revenue per channel for completed orders
overall_avg = completed_only.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the overall average revenue for each channel
print(f"Overall average revenue (email): {overall_avg['email']:.2f}")
print(f"Overall average revenue (paid_search): {overall_avg['paid_search']:.2f}")

# Compute difference
diff_overall = overall_avg['email'] - overall_avg['paid_search']
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {diff_overall:.2f}")

# Also compute stratified averages for full context
stratified_avg = completed_only.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue_clean'].mean().unstack(level='channel')
print("\nStratified average revenue per channel:")
print(stratified_avg)

# Print the difference within each segment
stratified_diff = stratified_avg['email'] - stratified_avg['paid_search']
print("\nDifference (email - paid_search) within each segment:")
print(stratified_diff)"}
